mapper.select: /* isry.sample.mapper.createmapper.selectRootMenuList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , (SELECT B.MENU_NO FROM SAB200 B WHERE UP_MENU_NO = 0 AND B.MENU_NM = A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM) AS SYS_MENU_NO FROM SAC100 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SRTNG_SQNCE

/* isry.sample.mapper.createmapper.selectBoardProgramInfo 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT PROGRM_ID, UNT_SYS_SE_CD, PROGRM_NM, OUTSD_PROGRM_YN, URL_ADDR, PROGRM_USE_SE_CD, RM_CN FROM SAB100 WHERE 1=1
AND RM_CN = 'BOARD_ID_' || #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO}

/* isry.sample.mapper.createmapper.selectCreateBoardColList 공통팀 유민상*/ SELECT A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO , A.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID , A.NTABRD_COL_NM , A.NTABRD_COL_TYPE_NM , A.NTABRD_TMPT_SE_CD , A.NTABRD_COL_SRTNG_SQNCE , A.ESNTL_YN , A.CMMNS_CD_ID , (SELECT B.CMMNS_CD_NM FROM SAC000 B WHERE B.CMMNS_CD_ID = A.CMMNS_CD_ID) AS CMMNS_CD_NM , A.WDTH_MXMM_PLACEM_YN , A.WDTH_SZ , A.COL_PLACEM_INFO_CN , A.DEL_YN , A.LIST_CONTRO_SIZEA_SZ , A.COL_BASS_VALUE FROM SBA100 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO = #{NTABRD_ESNTAL_NO} AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y'
ORDER BY A.NTABRD_COL_ESNTAL_ID

/* isry.sample.mapper.createmapper.selectCreateBoardcmmnsCdList 공통팀 유민상*/ WITH TEMP AS ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID , CMMNS_CD_NM FROM SAC000 WHERE 1=1
AND CMMNS_CD_ID LIKE '%' || #{CMMNS_CD_ID} || '%'
AND CMMNS_CD_NM LIKE '%' || #{CMMNS_CD_NM} || '%'
ORDER BY CMMNS_CD_ID OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY )
SELECT T.CMMNS_CD_ID , T.CMMNS_CD_NM , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , C.SRTNG_SQNCE FROM TEMP T, SAC100 C WHERE T.CMMNS_CD_ID = C.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) ORDER BY T.CMMNS_CD_ID, C.SRTNG_SQNCE
